scenario.summary: Healthcare organizations are facing an escalation in cyberattacks characterized by AI-enhanced phishing, compromised credentials, and supply chain vulnerabilities in AI vendors. These incidents frequently lead to operational disruptions through ransomware encryption of patient records or the unauthorized leakage of sensitive medical data via AI prompts.

meta.rationale: Focus on accounts for healthcare practitioners and administrative staff who have access to sensitive patient systems. The lead query narrows the investigation to only those accounts showing immediate signs of identity risk, while the parallel queries allow for deep dives into phishing and AI supply chain interaction.
meta.hypothesis: An attacker has compromised healthcare worker accounts via AI-crafted phishing to gain access to sensitive clinical portals or manipulate third-party AI service integrations.

hunt.name: Healthcare Identity and AI Supply Chain Compromise
hunt.description: Healthcare organizations face increasing operational disruption from identity-driven attacks. This hunt uses a gated approach to identify suspicious authentication patterns—such as high-volume failures or automated script-based logins—before expanding into more expensive telemetry. If a lead is confirmed, the hunt fans out to investigate interactions with rare phishing domains and audits cloud API activity for unauthorized interactions with AI platforms like OpenAI, Bedrock, or Copilot, which may indicate supply chain risk or data exfiltration.

The lead query narrows the investigation to only those accounts showing immediate signs of identity risk, while the parallel queries allow for deep dives into phishing and AI supply chain interaction.
config.beyond_detection: A simple rule can flag a failed login, but this hunt links those failures to the prevalence of rare web requests and specifically monitors the usage of cloud AI services to identify context-aware supply chain risks that isolated alerts miss.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, actor_user_name, src_endpoint_ip, user_agent, status_detail, COUNT(*) AS attempts, MIN(time) AS first_seen, MAX(time) AS last_seen FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE (status_id = 2 OR (user_agent IS NOT NULL AND (LOWER(user_agent) LIKE '%python%' OR LOWER(user_agent) LIKE '%script%'))) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, actor_user_name, src_endpoint_ip, user_agent, status_detail HAVING attempts > 5 OR (LOWER(user_agent) LIKE '%python%' OR LOWER(user_agent) LIKE '%script%') ORDER BY attempts DESC
config.description: Identify potential account compromise via high-frequency failures or automated login attempts.
config.expected_signal: Rows show repeated failures for specific users or sign-ins using non-browser user agents. Silence suggests no obvious automated account attacks.

config.objective: Determine if the sign-in patterns in lead-auth-anomalies suggest active credential stuffing or unauthorized automation.
config.description: Decide if the authentication patterns warrant a deeper investigation into phishing and AI usage.
config.expected_signal: A per-user or per-IP verdict on whether the activity is suspicious.
config.success_criteria: A verdict of suspicious | benign for the detected accounts.

config.question: the evaluate-auth-lead verdict is suspicious for at least one account or source IP
config.condition: the evaluate-auth-lead verdict is suspicious for at least one account or source IP
config.description: Halt the hunt if the lead query does not produce credible evidence of compromise.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, url_hostname, url_path, COUNT(*) AS requests, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_http_activity WHERE (instr(',' || '{{phishing_domains}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(url_hostname) || ',') > 0 OR LOWER(url_path) LIKE '%/login%' OR LOWER(url_path) LIKE '%/verify%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, url_hostname, url_path HAVING requests < 100 ORDER BY requests ASC
config.description: Identify hosts interacting with rare or healthcare-themed phishing domains within the scoped set.
config.expected_signal: Rare domains appearing on fewer than 5 hosts matching phishing keywords. Silence means no suspicious web traffic was recorded on the scoped hosts.
